libraries.title: Your libraries live here
libraries.description: Libraries appear here once created. Use the + button to add your first one, then click any library to browse its books.

smartScopes.title: Smart Scopes - Smart filters
smartScopes.description: Smart Scopes are saved filter rules that always stay up to date. Define criteria once - like "unread sci-fi" - and browse that slice of your library instantly.

collections.title: Collections - curated lists
collections.description: Collections are manual lists you build yourself - great for reading orders, recommendations, or syncing a specific set of books to your Kobo.

globalSearch.title: Search your collection
globalSearch.description: Use the search bar to instantly find any book, author, or series across your library.

bookDock.title: Book Dock
bookDock.description: Uploaded files wait here. Review metadata, set the target library, then finalize to add them to your collection.

statistics.title: Reading statistics
statistics.description: Explore 33+ charts covering your reading pace, genre breakdown, session patterns, top authors, and more. Your full reading history at a glance.

upload.title: Upload books
upload.description: Upload books directly from your browser. They land in the Book Dock for metadata review before being added to a library.

appearance.title: Make it yours
appearance.description: Customize your theme, accent color, and background from the appearance menu.
